groups.label: A dog giving her days a start and a shape
groups.note: Up at seven and out by half past, where the days before had no start. Eating properly again sits with it.
groups.description: Up at seven after two years with nothing to get up for

groups.label: Out on the green and among people again
groups.note: A society she had lived beside for twenty years, open to her with the dog. The talk comes round the edges, and she gives help back.
groups.description: A morning society she lived beside for twenty years, open to her with a dog

groups.label: Keeping Pepper after the fall, against her daughter
groups.note: The fall, the row in the car and the classes. She holds on, and her daughter comes round without a word said about it.
groups.description: A broken wrist, the one proper row in years, and holding on

groups.label: Making sure Pepper is never left waiting for her
groups.note: The thought of losing turned round: she expects to go first, and has put the dog's future in writing. The dog waiting at the door is the picture she could not bear.
groups.description: Expecting to go first, she writes the dog a future

groups.label: Life in the house again, and someone to tell
groups.note: Mess where things used to stay put, a listener for forty years of telling, breathing in the night. Dennis is close in all of it.
groups.description: Mess, breathing in the night and a listener, where things used to stay put

groups.label: Eating again, and sitting down to it
groups.description: No more toast standing up, with someone depending on her

groups.label: Told the dog had to go
groups.note: The row and its mending, neither talked through.
groups.description: Treated like a child, and mended with a chew

groups.label: Learning to stop dead
groups.description: Classes at seventy three, standing like a lamppost

groups.label: Telling her what she would have told Dennis
groups.description: Forty years of telling someone her day, with nowhere for it to go until now
